# shopflow_dbt -- capstone reference solution (Chapter 26)

This repository is the reference solution of the ShopFlow capstone project of
*The dbt Analytics Engineering Bible*. Each milestone of Chapter 26 is one commit
with an annotated tag: `m00`, `m01`, ... `m14`.

## Layout expected on your machine
```
~/dbt-course/
  shopflow-data/      # copy of labs/capstone (data/, setup.sql, updates/) + shopflow.duckdb
  shopflow_dbt/       # this dbt project (your own repo)
```
Build the raw database once: `cd ~/dbt-course/shopflow-data && duckdb shopflow.duckdb < setup.sql`.

## Use the tags to compare with your work
```bash
git tag -n                      # list milestones with their message
git diff m03 m04 --stat         # what changed in one milestone
git checkout m04                # look at the solution of milestone 4 (read-only visit)
git switch main                 # come back
```
Copy `profiles.example.yml` into `~/.dbt/profiles.yml` (profile name `shopflow`).
Always run dbt from this folder (the database path is relative).

name: 'shopflow_dbt'
version: '1.0.0'

# the profile (connection) defined in ~/.dbt/profiles.yml
profile: 'shopflow'

model-paths: ["models"]
analysis-paths: ["analyses"]
test-paths: ["tests"]
seed-paths: ["seeds"]
macro-paths: ["macros"]
snapshot-paths: ["snapshots"]

clean-targets:
  - "target"
  - "dbt_packages"

models:
  shopflow_dbt:
    staging:
      +materialized: view

models:
  - name: stg_payments_provider__payments
    description: One row per payment attempt. amount is in currency units (cents / 100).
    columns:
      - name: payment_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

  - name: stg_payments_provider__refunds
    description: One row per refund. refunded_at is a real timestamp.
    columns:
      - name: refund_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

sources:
  - name: payments_provider
    description: Daily export of the payment provider. Amounts are integers in CENTS.
    schema: payments_provider
    tables:
      - name: payments
        description: One row per payment attempt (failed attempts included).
        config:
          loaded_at_field: _loaded_at
          freshness:
            warn_after: {count: 12, period: hour}
            error_after: {count: 24, period: hour}
      - name: refunds
        description: Money sent back to customers. refunded_at is TEXT (DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI).

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('payments_provider', 'payments') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        payment_id,
        order_id,
        payment_method,
        status                                     as payment_status,
        cast(amount_cents / 100 as decimal(18, 2)) as amount,   -- cents -> currency units
        currency                                   as currency_code,
        created_at
    from source

)

select * from renamed

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('payments_provider', 'refunds') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        refund_id,
        payment_id,
        cast(amount_cents / 100 as decimal(18, 2)) as amount,
        reason                                     as refund_reason,
        -- the provider sends text like '12/07/2025 06:29' (day first): a plain cast fails
        strptime(refunded_at, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M')    as refunded_at
    from source

)

select * from renamed

models:
  - name: stg_shipping__shipments
    description: One row per shipment with its latest status.
    columns:
      - name: shipment_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

sources:
  - name: shipping
    description: Shipment feed from the carriers.
    schema: shipping
    config:
      loaded_at_field: _loaded_at
      freshness:
        warn_after: {count: 24, period: hour}
        error_after: {count: 48, period: hour}
    tables:
      - name: shipments
        description: One row per shipment, with its latest status.

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('shipping', 'shipments') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        shipment_id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        tracking_number,
        status as shipment_status,
        shipped_at,
        delivered_at,
        updated_at
    from source

)

select * from renamed

models:
  - name: stg_shopflow_app__customers
    description: One row per customer (latest version), email cleaned (trim + lower case).
    columns:
      - name: customer_id
        description: Primary key of a customer.
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: email
        description: Lower-case email without spaces. Can be NULL.

  - name: stg_shopflow_app__addresses
    description: One row per address.
    columns:
      - name: address_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

  - name: stg_shopflow_app__products
    description: One row per product. price is in currency_code (EUR, USD or MAD).
    columns:
      - name: product_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

  - name: stg_shopflow_app__orders
    description: One row per order with its current status.
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

  - name: stg_shopflow_app__order_items
    description: One row per order line. Amounts are in the order currency.
    columns:
      - name: order_item_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

sources:
  - name: shopflow_app
    description: Copy of the ShopFlow application database, loaded every night by the EL tool.
    schema: shopflow_app
    tables:
      - name: customers
        description: One row per customer account (the export can contain an old copy of a row).
      - name: addresses
        description: Shipping and billing addresses of the customers.
      - name: products
        description: Product catalogue. Prices are in the currency of the listing (EUR, USD or MAD).
      - name: orders
        description: One row per order, with its current status.
        config:
          loaded_at_field: _loaded_at
          freshness:
            warn_after: {count: 12, period: hour}
            error_after: {count: 24, period: hour}
      - name: order_items
        description: One row per product line of an order. unit_price is in the order currency.

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('shopflow_app', 'addresses') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        address_id,
        customer_id,
        address_type,
        city,
        postal_code,
        upper(country_code) as country_code,
        is_default
    from source

)

select * from renamed

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('shopflow_app', 'customers') }}

),

deduplicated as (

    -- the app export can contain an OLD copy of a customer row:
    -- keep only the most recent version of each customer_id
    select *
    from source
    qualify row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by updated_at desc) = 1

),

renamed as (

    select
        customer_id,
        lower(trim(email))  as email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        upper(country_code) as country_code,
        created_at,
        updated_at
    from deduplicated

)

select * from renamed

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('shopflow_app', 'order_items') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,                          -- in the currency of the order
        quantity * unit_price as line_amount
    from source

)

select * from renamed

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('shopflow_app', 'orders') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_at,
        cast(order_at as date) as order_date,
        status                 as order_status,
        currency               as currency_code,
        shipping_address_id,
        updated_at
    from source

)

select * from renamed

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('shopflow_app', 'products') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        product_id,
        sku,
        product_name,
        category,
        price,
        currency as currency_code,
        is_active,
        created_at,
        updated_at
    from source

)

select * from renamed

models:
  - name: stg_web_analytics__events
    description: One row per tracked event, duplicates removed.
    columns:
      - name: event_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

sources:
  - name: web_analytics
    description: Events sent by the website tracker (installed on 2025-10-01).
    schema: web_analytics
    config:
      loaded_at_field: _loaded_at
      freshness:
        warn_after: {count: 6, period: hour}
        error_after: {count: 24, period: hour}
    tables:
      - name: events
        description: One row per tracked event. The tracker sometimes sends an event twice.

with source as (

    select * from {{ source('web_analytics', 'events') }}

),

deduplicated as (

    -- the tracker sometimes sends the same event twice: keep the first copy received
    select *
    from source
    qualify row_number() over (partition by event_id order by _loaded_at) = 1

),

renamed as (

    select
        event_id,
        session_id,
        customer_id,                 -- NULL when the visitor is not logged in
        event_type,
        event_timestamp as event_at,
        page            as page_path,
        _loaded_at      as loaded_at
    from deduplicated

)

select * from renamed

# Copy this block into ~/.dbt/profiles.yml (do NOT commit your real profiles.yml).
# Run dbt from the shopflow_dbt folder: the default path is relative to it.
shopflow:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: duckdb
      path: "{{ env_var('SHOPFLOW_DB_PATH', '../shopflow-data/shopflow.duckdb') }}"
      schema: dbt_adnane
      threads: 4
    prod:
      type: duckdb
      path: "{{ env_var('SHOPFLOW_DB_PATH', '../shopflow-data/shopflow.duckdb') }}"
      schema: prod
      threads: 4

seeds:
  - name: exchange_rates
    description: >
      Monthly exchange rates used by finance. 1 unit of currency_code = rate_to_eur EUR.
      One row per currency and month (first day of the month).
    config:
      column_types:
        currency_code: varchar
        rate_month: date
        rate_to_eur: decimal(12, 6)
    columns:
      - name: currency_code
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: rate_month
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: rate_to_eur
        data_tests: [not_null]

  - name: country_regions
    description: Country code -> country name, sales region and default currency.
    config:
      column_types:
        country_code: varchar
        country_name: varchar
        region: varchar
        default_currency: varchar
    columns:
      - name: country_code
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

country_code,country_name,region,default_currency
